newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to issue five-day repos.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to issue five-day repos.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea (BOK) said on Monday it has decided to issue five-day repurchase agreements (repos) to soak up excess liquidity from the banking system.
This is the first time the central bank has not set the amount of liquidity it plans to absorb.
The central bank planned to invite a tender on Monday morning to sell the five-day repos.
Banks, which offer reasonable interest rates, will be eligible to underwrite the issue. But the central bank declined to give details on the reasonable rates.
Meanwhile, the BOK will redeem 1.88 trillion won worth of repos maturing on Monday from the banking system, which will loosen liquidity among banks.
